h1: Tablet, foldable and Wear OS apps
overview: Android runs on many screen sizes, and one stretched phone layout rarely looks right on all of them. We adapt your app for tablets and foldables with list and detail panes and window size classes, and build Wear OS screens and tiles for watches. We test on emulators for each form factor and on real devices where available, then prepare the build for your Play Console.

faq: Do I need an existing phone app?
Yes. These layouts extend an app you already have, so we need the project source. If you have no app yet, order an Android build and we plan tablet and watch screens into it.
Will tablet layouts matter for my Play listing?
Google publishes large screen app quality guidelines, and we build to them. We cannot promise any store placement, but we do prepare tablet screenshots for your listing.
Can the Wear OS app run without the phone?
It can for simple features, but most useful watch apps sync with the phone app. We explain the tradeoff and build whichever fits your use case, within the package limit.
Which devices do you test on?
We use Android Studio emulators for phone, tablet, foldable and watch sizes, and real devices where we have them. If you must support a specific model, tell us and we check it.
